page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Hebrew headwords and Latin glosses. Page number at top left. Running head at top centre. Signature at the foot.

main_text.l: מִכְסָא m. Tempus statum & quasi numeratum, Dies fixus, Feria stativa.
כָּסַף Appetere, Expetere. Niphal נִכְסַף Desiderio affici vel teneri.
כֶּסֶף m. Argentum, quasi Expetibile dictum: Nummi, Pecunia argentea: plur. כְּסָפִים.
כַּעַן Chald. Jam, Nunc, כְּעֶנֶת Vide in עַתָּה.
כָּעַס Indignari. Pihel כִּעֵס Ad indignationem provocare, Irritare. Hiphil הִכְעִיס idem.
כַּעַשׂ כַּעַשׂ m. Indignatio: plur. כְּעָסִים.
כָּפַל Duplicare, Conduplicare. Niphal נִכְפַּל Duplicari.
כֶּפֶל m. Duplum, Duplex: duale, כְּפָלַיִם.
מַכְפֵּלָה f. Machpela, nomen proprium loci quibusdam, Duplicitas, Duplex fossa.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords and vowel pointing are read from a faded scan and are doubtful in places, notably the entries at the lines marked כְּסָתוֹת, כַּעַשׂ and כַּפִּים. The page number "151" at top left is uncertain (it could read 131). The running head is in Hebrew letters. No marginal notes are printed.
